summary: Learn to manage blended human and AI work with RACI, OKRs, process mining, and governance templates. Enrol in human-agent teaming training.
lede: Human-agent teaming and digital workforce management helps professionals organize work shared by people, software agents, and automated workflows. It is designed for professionals managing blended teams and digital workflows who need to assign work and maintain oversight. Learners practice mapping responsibilities and decision rights, setting routing and escalation rules, and measuring capacity and performance.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who manage blended teams, digital workflows, and AI-supported operations and need practical control over work allocation, governance, and performance.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in team coordination, operations, workforce planning, process improvement, or digital transformation. Familiarity with KPIs, basic reporting, and common collaboration tools is helpful. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reviewing workflow maps, performance reports, and AI-supported task allocation examples.
